meta.title: 咖啡拉花技巧｜3步学会大白心，要点详解
meta.title_en: Learn the Big Heart Latte Art in 3 Steps
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 大白心三步法

scenes.context: 奶缸里的牛奶必须持续晃动融合，停 5 秒就分层失去流动性。
sentences: 奶缸的牛奶一定要在手里不要闲下来。
The milk in the pitcher must never sit idle in your hand.
sit idle（闲下来）
停了 5 秒都分层。
Leave it for five seconds and it separates.
separate（分层）
靠着奶缸壁摇晃，能看到大漩涡。
Swirl against the pitcher wall and you'll see a big vortex.
vortex（漩涡）
paraphrase: Keep the milk and foam moving together at all times.
Rock the pitcher against its own wall to blend the foam.
scenes.speak: The milk in the pitcher must never sit idle in your hand. Leave it for five seconds and it separates. Swirl against the pitcher wall and you'll see a big vortex.

scenes.context: 从液面高约 10 公分处开始倒，瞄准液面最深的位置。
sentences: 从液面高到 10 公分左右。
Start about 10 centimeters above the surface.
centimeters（公分）
瞄准液面最深的位置。
Aim for the deepest point of the surface.
deepest point（最深点）
牛奶和奶泡一起注到咖啡下面去。
The milk and foam pour together under the coffee surface.
pour together（一起注入）
paraphrase: Set a steady stream to blend the milk into the crema.
Target where the surface dips the most.
scenes.speak: Start about 10 centimeters above the surface. Aim for the deepest point of the surface. The milk and foam pour together under the coffee surface.

scenes.title_en: Steps Two and Three: Pour and Finish
scenes.context: 到半满时放下奶缸从液面中心偏下注入，收尾时抬高 5 公分翘起。
sentences: 从液面中心偏下开始注入。
Begin pouring just below the center of the surface.
below the center（中心偏下）
把奶缸抬高 5 公分收尾。
Lift the pitcher 5 centimeters to finish.
finish（收尾）
稍微翘起来，流量变小。
Tilt it slightly so the flow softens.
soften（变小/变柔）
paraphrase: Start the pour just under the middle of the cup.
A quick lift to close off the pattern.
scenes.speak: Begin pouring just below the center of the surface. Lift the pitcher 5 centimeters to finish. Tilt it slightly so the flow softens.

scenes.context: 老师强调只要给角度和位置，以及何时注、何时倾斜、何时提高、何时收尾，就是拉花的全部。
sentences: 我只要给你做一个角度、位置。
All I give you is an angle and a position.
angle（角度）
什么时间注、什么时间倾斜。
When to pour, when to tilt.
when to（何时）
什么时间提高、什么时间收尾。
When to lift, when to finish.
lift（提高）
paraphrase: It all comes down to where and at what angle you pour.
The timing of each move is the whole skill.
scenes.speak: All I give you is an angle and a position. When to pour, when to tilt. When to lift, when to finish.

practice: 牛奶为什么要一直晃动？
To keep the foam and milk mixed — they separate in seconds.
第一步油质稳定从多高开始？
Just below the center of the surface.
Lift the pitcher 5 cm and tilt it slightly.
footer_notes: ASR 校正：转录「油质」按语境统一为「奶泡+牛奶」流动性描述。
